resources.string: Nothing here yet. Tap Edit to start writing.
A blank page, ready for your next poem.

Swipe the page
and it will turn.

Tap Edit above
to make these lines your own,
then open Contents
to find your way back.
Write your own poems, one to a page, and turn through them like a real book.

Each poem is saved as a plain text file in a folder you choose, named after the poem. Because the folder is outside the app, your poems are still there if you reinstall it.\n\nPick or create a folder such as Documents/Poems, then allow PoetryBook to use it.
That folder couldn\'t be used. Please choose another one.
PoetryBook can no longer reach your poems folder. Choose it again, or pick a new one.
Every poem is a text file here, named after its title.
Choosing a different folder loads the poems in that folder. Your current poems stay in the old folder.
The book will load the poems in the folder you choose. Your current poems will be left in the old folder, where they are now.
